# Native desktop XMind sample

Created 2026-10-12 with /Applications/Xmind.app, version 24.04.10311 build 2024052619230, through native UI. New local document only; no existing user document modified, no sign-in, subscription, cloud upload or publication. A trial offer was dismissed. Saved inside the current repository.

The sample contains two sheets, 14 topics, attached hierarchy including a third level, Chinese/English titles, a root PNG image and multi-line long notes. The second sheet root has an explicit font-size26 and bold override. Theme styles originate from the basic mind-map template. The image is our synthetic T06 browser screenshot, not user content. The archive has native content.json plus content.xml compatibility notice; JSON must win. Expected tree/content/style and hashes are in expected.json.

The File→Export menu offers PNG/JPEG/SVG/PDF/Markdown/Word/Excel/PowerPoint/OPML/TextBundle, no legacy-XMind exporter. This sample does not prove old desktop versions or genuine XML-only exporter compatibility. It is genuine native output of the stated version, not a hand-built ZIP.

T12 implementer may copy this unchanged archive and relevant provenance into tracked test fixtures and use it in actual import/browser persistence tests. Test sample content is owned synthetic data and may be included in this project.
